description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Korvold's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
